title: Paginate catalog results without duplicate items or mutating filters
goal: Make the catalog service return every page of search results.
initial_requirements: Fetch all catalog pages in order until the service reports no next page.

steering.requirement: Keep the caller's filters unchanged and suppress duplicate item IDs when pages overlap while preserving first-seen order.

verifiers.name: all
verifiers.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s "$DRIFTCTL_EVAL_CASE_DIR/steering" -p 'test_integration_*.py'

expected_boundary: The visible pagination cases use disjoint pages, so a simple page loop can pass. The held-out integration verifier uses overlapping pages and checks caller immutability, exposing loss of the late steering constraints.
